mtn_peak_a.notes: Snow-capped mountain, 90 m to a summit ridge that steps down to the south-east, ~74 x 64 m at the ground (aretes reach ~80 x 71 m just below it). Big flat violet facets, aretes and snow-filled couloirs; snow over the upward faces of the upper half. Backdrop landmark; the base sinks ~6 m below the pivot, so it sits on rough or sloping ground. Turn it freely: colours assume no sun direction. The cylinder is the solid core only; keep the player off the flanks with terrain.

mtn_peak_b.notes: Broad double-summit massif: 70 m west summit, 61 m east summit, a snowy saddle at ~45 m between, ~100 x 66 m at the ground, long axis on X. Backdrop landmark; base sinks ~6 m. The box is the solid core.

mtn_cliff_a.notes: Faceted violet-grey cliff wall chunk, front faces -Y (glTF +Z): three broad back masses (the middle one 25 m with a snow cap) and three lower front masses whose tops are grass ledges with turf lips. Lay it against steep terrain with its back (+Y) in the slope; base sinks 2 m. Several side by side, rotated and scaled 0.8-1.3, make a long wall. The front masses and scree stand ~2 m proud of the box.

mtn_cliff_b.notes: Tall crag or buttress, 35 m, a leaning pointed wedge with two shoulders and a grassy front ledge; front faces -Y. Use at gorge rims and as a vertical accent among mtn_cliff_a walls; base sinks 2-3 m.

mtn_rock_large.notes: Pale faceted outcrop of four chunky blocks, like the concept's foreground rocks. Beside trails and on meadow edges; base sinks 0.6 m.

mtn_boulder.notes: Rounded-faceted meadow boulder ~2.5 m across. Scatter in loose groups of 2-5 at mixed scale (0.4-1.3) and yaw over meadows; base sinks 0.25 m.

mtn_boulder_flat.notes: Low chamfered slab 3 x 2 x 1 m. Mix with mtn_boulder in meadows and at path edges; also works as a stepping stone. Base sinks 0.2 m.

mtn_pine.notes: Tall layered conifer, 14 m, olive-topped tiers with dark undersides. Scatter in loose stands on slopes and along the trail; vary yaw and scale 0.8-1.25. Collider is the trunk.

mtn_pine_small.notes: Young conifer, 7 m. Mix with mtn_pine at stand edges and on cliff ledges.

mtn_rope_bridge.notes: Sagging rope suspension bridge spanning X: 40 m between the two post pairs at x = +-20.15 (planks run on 1.4 m past each), deck 1.6 m wide, 2 m sag at mid-span, hand rails 1.05 m above the deck. The pivot is at deck level at the ends: put both ends on the gorge rims at the same height. Walk surface: not carried by a collider; the game must supply one (a deck ribbon following y = -2 * (1 - (x / 20)^2), |x| <= 20, width 1.6). Post colliders (r 0.15 at x = +-20.15, z = +-0.98) are optional.

mtn_watchtower_ruin.notes: Ruined stone watchtower ~6.5 m wide, 14-15 m tall, broken crenellated top (high at the back left), arched door and two steps on the front (-Y), rubble at the base out to ~5 m. Place on a grassy cliff ledge with the door facing the path. The door is closed; the box is the tower body, rubble has no collider.

mtn_fence.notes: Post-and-rail fence segment, 3 m along X, 1.1 m tall. Posts at x = -1.5 and 0; tile segments end to end every 3 m along X (the next segment's first post closes the joint) and finish a run with one more post-only segment or leave it open. Rails sit on the -Y side: put that side toward the path. Small yaw changes at joints follow a curving path.

mtn_steps.notes: Wooden-edged earth steps, 2 m wide, six 0.25 m risers rising 1.5 m over 3 m toward +Y (bottom step at -Y). Walk surface: shape the terrain (or a ramp collider) to the 1:2 slope under it; the steps are visual. Chain them up a trail, each 1.5 m higher and 3 m further.

mtn_wildflowers.notes: 3 x 3 m ground patch of grass tufts with drifts of white daisies, yellow buttercups, orange poppies and blue spikes. Decal-like: scatter many over meadows and trail edges at any yaw and scale 0.7-1.4; no base, so it sits on any terrain.

mtn_snow_drift.notes: Low faceted wind-blown snow mound, 6 x 3.5 x 1 m, with two rock tips poking through; the crest leans to +Y (lee side). Scatter above the tree line and at cliff feet; base sinks 0.25 m. Walkable: terrain carries the player.
